newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Nov foreign currency deposits hit record.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Nov foreign currency deposits hit record.

text.p: Taiwan's foreign currency deposits outstanding hit a record-high of T$323.6 billion at the end of November, boosted by the island's continued trade surplus, the central bank said on Saturday.
The end-November figure was up from T$293.8 billion at the end of October, the central bank said in a statement.
Taiwan's trade surplus in November was US$1.294 billion despite being down 9.1 percent compared to the same month in 1995.
The bank also attributed the high deposits outstanding to exporters growing accustomed to paying for raw material imports directly with foreign currency, rather than use Taiwan dollars.
